label: Closing date
definition: Date identified by the source as completion of the original closing for the mapped loan or facility. The source must establish the closing event and the loan or facility represented.
notes: Do not equate signing, funding, effective date, amendment closing, acquisition or secondary settlement with original closing without source confirmation. Calendar applicability is separate.

label: Original maturity date
definition: Contractual final maturity specified when the mapped loan or facility was originally established, before subsequent changes to that maturity.
notes: Keep distinct from current, projected, reinvested, springing and adjusted payment dates. A generic Maturity Date header does not establish this meaning.

label: Current maturity date
definition: Contractual final maturity represented by the source as in effect for the mapped loan or facility at the supplied reporting date, incorporating applicable effective amendments or extensions.
notes: Aliases are search suggestions only. Confirm meaning and as-of context; do not infer an extension, springing-maturity condition or business-day adjustment from this field alone.

label: Reporting date
definition: Calendar date to which the supplied report or portfolio information relates, as stated by the source.
notes: Confirm any cut-off alias against its source definition. Do not substitute the application session date, file modification time, delivery date or report creation timestamp.
